content_sections.heading: IREL Tradesman Trainee Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: IREL has notified 131 Tradesman Trainee positions across four trades. Fitter accounts for 93 vacancies, followed by AOCP, Electrician and Instrumentation. Unit Selection Rule: Candidates can apply for only one trade and one unit/location. Final merit lists will be prepared separately for each trade, category and unit.

content_sections.heading: IREL Tradesman Trainee Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualification and two years of relevant experience in their selected trade by 9 November 2026 . Important: The AOCP post provides an alternative 10+2 Science eligibility route with Chemistry and a minimum of 50% aggregate marks. Candidates applying through this route must still satisfy the two-year relevant experience requirement. Existing employees on IREL's regular rolls are eligible under the special educational qualification route of SSC with four years of experience in the relevant trade or operation , subject to the notification's other conditions. Two years of relevant post-qualification experience is required for external applicants. Apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961, will be counted toward relevant experience. On-the-job training may be included where it meets the relevant trade conditions. Teaching or Research Fellowship experience is not accepted as relevant post-qualification work experience. Prescribed qualifications must be obtained through full-time regular courses recognized by the applicable competent authorities. Applicants must provide valid experience documentation when required for verification.

content_sections.heading: IREL Tradesman Trainee Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 35 years as of 9 November 2026 , subject to applicable category and service-based relaxations. Age Ceiling: The candidate's age after all permissible relaxations must not exceed 50 years. Reserved-category relaxation is subject to the reservation availability and conditions for the selected trade and unit. Candidates applying against unreserved vacancies must meet the applicable general eligibility standards.

content_sections.heading: IREL Tradesman Trainee Stipend and Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo one year of training and receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 34,200 per month . Consolidated monthly stipend of Rs. 34,200. House Rent Allowance at the applicable posting-location rate, calculated on the minimum basic pay of Rs. 22,000, if company bachelor accommodation is not provided. Medical facilities for the trainee and eligible dependent family members as applicable to W-3 grade employees. On successful completion of training, trainees may be absorbed as regular Tradesmen in W-3 Grade, carrying the pay scale of Rs. 22,000–88,000. Eligible regular employees may receive Industrial Dearness Allowance, HRA, increments, medical facilities, leave encashment, incentives, uniforms, provident fund, gratuity and other benefits according to company rules. Salary Clarification: The approximate annual CTC of Rs. 6.5 lakh applies after absorption into regular employment and is calculated using an assumed 20% HRA for a Y-class city. It is not the training-period salary or guaranteed in-hand pay.

content_sections.heading: IREL Tradesman Trainee Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill Test or Trade Test and document verification. Computer Based Written Examination. Shortlisting for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:5 based on CBT merit. Qualifying Skill Test / Trade Test or Computer Proficiency Test, as applicable. Preparation of unit-wise, trade-wise and category-wise merit lists using CBT marks. Document Verification. Pre-employment Medical Examination and other prescribed verification. Final Merit Rule: Only candidates qualifying in the Skill Test will be considered for final selection. Final merit will be determined using CBT marks only. Skill Test marks will not be added to the final merit.

content_sections.heading: IREL Tradesman Trainee Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination will be a Computer Based Test containing 150 multiple-choice questions for 150 marks . The examination duration is two hours, and there is no negative marking. Important Exam Rule: Candidates must secure the prescribed minimum qualifying percentage separately in Section I and Section II. Obtaining the required percentage in the combined total alone is not sufficient.

content_sections.heading: IREL Tradesman Trainee Job Location 2026
content_sections.text: Vacancies are available at IREL units in Odisha, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh. The initial posting location will be based on the unit selected by the candidate during the online application. Requests to change the selected initial posting location will not be entertained. Transfer Condition: After appointment, employees are liable to be transferred to any IREL unit, office or project site in India. Applicants must be willing to serve anywhere in the country.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IREL Tradesman Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload the prescribed documents during registration and produce additional eligibility documents when called for the Skill Test or verification. Valid personal email address and mobile number. Recent passport-size colour photograph. Scanned signature. SSLC / Matriculation Certificate or Birth Certificate for age proof. ITI or National Apprenticeship Certificate in the selected trade, where applicable. 10+2 Science qualification documents for eligible AOCP applicants using that route. Valid statutory licence for Electrician applicants. Relevant work-experience certificates, appointment orders or payslips. Category Certificate for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates, where applicable. Valid Ex-servicemen service or discharge certificate, where applicable. Other certificates supporting age relaxation or eligibility claims. No Objection Certificate from the employer, where applicable. Important: Candidates shortlisted for the Skill Test must produce Aadhaar identification, age proof, qualification certificates and experience records. Failure to submit the required documents may result in rejection.
